_comment: WFAIA 広告部門 ふくふく亭（7F仕出し）出前広告（約28秒・9:16縦）のショット表。単体キャラの 2:3 スチルは 9:16 に上下トリム＋わずかな拡張で使える。i2v_style_suffix は anime-shots.json と共通。

brand.rule: 受け渡し（協働）のカットでのみ、灯火橙と相手社の色が同時に出てよい

shots.start_frame: f7_hikari v1 (fbe2b147) を 9:16 トリム
shots.motion: The tower of trunks sways dangerously into frame from below as the girl puppet runs in place; the topmost box nearly tips, then settles. Her candle-flame eyes blink once. Slight handheld shake.
The girl places a wooden lunch box into the printer puppet's outstretched ink-black fingers. On the handoff, a warm orange glow and a proof-red glow bloom together in the dim workshop. Camera locked.

shots.gen_prompt: Two references show two finished puppet characters. Reproduce BOTH exactly as designed. The small girl puppet from the first image offers a wooden lunch box toward the faceless still-device puppet from the second image, which lowers one dark elongated hand to receive it; a thin wisp of vapor curls from its spout. Warm lantern-orange glow on her side, pale scent-violet glow on its side. Same handcrafted stop-motion puppet finish, practical miniature lighting, film grain. Vertical composition, both figures in frame. No text, no watermark.
shots.motion: The device-headed puppet accepts the box; vapor puffs once from its spout like a satisfied breath. Orange and violet glows brighten together. Camera locked.

shots.gen_prompt: Two references show two finished puppet characters. Reproduce BOTH exactly as designed. The small girl puppet from the first image hands a wooden lunch box to the tall black-robed puppet from the second image, whose pale hands emerge from the robe to take it; the small bell at the robed figure's collar swings once. Warm lantern-orange glow on the girl's side, chrysanthemum bone-white glow on the robed figure's side. Same handcrafted stop-motion puppet finish, practical miniature lighting, film grain. Vertical composition. No text, no watermark.
shots.motion: The robed puppet receives the box with both pale hands; the collar bell swings once and settles. Orange and bone-white glows brighten together. Camera locked.
From bottom to top, the eight colored glows light up one after another in quick rhythm, like floors receiving their meals; fog swirls gently around each new light. Camera locked.
